title: Smooth daughter-neutrino reprocessing extension of the 10 MeV B.2 high-energy band

method.source: Literal Eq. (B.1) source, frozen at Rmax=25 km
method.baseline_opacity: Literal scalar B.2 reduced opacity inside 25 km
method.outer_smooth_opacity: Two-flavour vacuum-limit V->nu nu opacity multiplied by (1-P_pair^E(omega,r))
method.pair_escape: Equal-mode average of daughter energy survival exp[-tau_nuN(E,r)] using P1G exponential density tail; L-only and transverse-only variants also evaluated

sharp_Rmax30_conditional.note: Full vacuum opacity over 25-30 km; this is the extreme sharp-boundary P1D diagnostic.

conclusions: The smooth transport-only reprocessing model changes the 210-510 MeV band by 0.33% (low tail), 4.14% (central equal-mode), and 10.60% (high tail equal-mode), compared with 70.94% for the sharp full-opacity Rmax=30 km extension.
The band-only total proxies remain 91.98%, 86.87%, and 78.21% above Fig. 7 for the low, central, and high equal-mode tails, respectively.

The near-match obtained by the sharp Rmax=30 km extension is not reproduced by the smooth daughter-scattering model. The boundary effect is real but does not explain the strong-endpoint discrepancy at the tested figure-level tail range.
Longitudinal/transverse mode choice changes the central and high-tail band shifts by a few percentage points, smaller than the difference between smooth and sharp boundary prescriptions.
No Rmax is fitted or selected; the literal 25 km baseline and all axial-vector outputs remain unchanged.
limitations: This is a transport-scattering proxy, not a heavy-flavor energy-sphere calculation. It treats a daughter scattering as reprocessing the daughter energy and omits the detailed energy-changing collision kernel.
The 20-25 km baryon-density tail is extrapolated from a figure-level read-off; low/central/high are stresses, not statistical uncertainties.
The actual production polarization density matrix is not known from the scalar B.16 output; L-only, transverse-only, and equal-mode diagnostics are shown.
The full total luminosity is a band-only proxy: all other energy bins are held at the V8 phase-space baseline.

The V8 phase-space total is a cross-runtime result with non-bitwise NumPy grid hashes; the B.1 source, Rmax25 band, and sharp Rmax30 band closures to the archived P1C/P1D results are at 1.9e-11, 5.0e-12, and 5.5e-12.
No production source, opacity normalization, baseline Rmax, Fig. 7 curve, or axial-vector output is modified.
